potential_clients.summary: Sohib Boundaoui from Flow Company has presented an integrated marketing service proposal to Jorge O at City Dental Studio across two meetings, offering a comprehensive system at $3,500 per month plus $1,500–$2,000 in ad spend. The practice currently spends $10,000 monthly on Zocdoc leads and has strong local SEO with 435 reviews and a 5-star rating, but needs to expand into nearby markets like Pembroke Pines following their recent location expansion. The proposed solution includes Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, automated lead recovery with text-back for missed calls, integration with their existing Weave and Open Dental CRM systems, and centralized WhatsApp communication, targeting 10 new patients per month by month three. The next step is a follow-up meeting scheduled for Wednesday at 10 AM Miami time where Jorge and Dr. Gabrielle Beckoff will review the proposal with their team.
